prompt: Build and code me a landing page that scrolls like a video for my bookshop, Paper Boat. I have no images.
output:
motion-craft plans the motion and writes the prompt; a coding agent or ui-craft builds the page.

## Direction
**Model:** M1 Pinned scene story  
**Look:** Editorial Luxury  
**Stack:** Tier 1 standalone HTML/CSS/JS  
**Motion craft:** Weighted response, masked line reveal, scale hand-over  
**Why:** M1 turns native scrolling into a three-scene pinned story without needing images. Editorial Luxury suits a bookshop through generous whitespace, warm paper ground, dark ink, and restrained serif display type; the drawn book motif supplies the visual anchor.

## Scene plan
| # | Scroll | On screen | Motion | Still version |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0-33% | “Paper Boat” beside a whole closed book on `#FAF8F4` | The book holds still, then the title exits | Whole closed book and “Paper Boat” |
| 2 | 33-67% | “A bookshop.” beside a close-up of the book’s page block on inverted `#171717` | The book scales toward its pages and opens slightly | Page-block close-up and “A bookshop.” |
| 3 | 67-100% | Centred closing lockup with the opened book above “Paper Boat” | The book settles into an open position and page layers shift | Open book above “Paper Boat” |

## Prompt
```text
GOAL: Build a cinematic scrollytelling landing page for Paper Boat, a bookshop, for visitors who want to understand the subject and remember Paper Boat. One index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no libraries; a Google Fonts link is allowed.

CONTENT: Scene 1: "Paper Boat". Scene 2: "A bookshop.". Scene 3: "Paper Boat". Add no other words or facts.

SCENES: Track 450vh. All percentages are of the whole track, from one progress value.

Motif: one unified open-book silhouette recognisable with no label: (a) main masses: 2 opposing curved page blocks meeting at a central fold, occupying at least 45% of the stage width and 35% of its height, in --motif-body; (b) identifying parts: exactly 2 covers, 1 central spine/fold, and 6 visible page-edge layers arranged as 3 on each side in --motif-highlight and --motif-shadow; (c) surface detail: 7 thin curved page-edge bands and 2 small corner-fold shapes in --motif-accent.

Draw it with care as one inline SVG: closed, filled, curved paths in at least three distinct palette hex tones (main body, lighter highlight, accent detail) bound to CSS variables inheriting each section/scene's theme, never a hardcoded dark fill) with a tight viewBox. No stick lines and no bare circles or rectangles standing in for the object. Whenever a scene or inverted band turns dark, update these CSS variables so dark SVG fills switch to light hex tones and every part stays clear across every scene.

Scene 1 | 0-33% | motif right, centre 50%/50% of its area, whole closed book at scale 1, rotation -4deg, field #FAF8F4 | closed book holds at scale 1 and rotation -4deg; page-edge bands remain settled | text hold 0-26, out 26-32
Scene 2 | 33-67% | motif left, centre 55%/45% of its area, close-up at scale 2 on the page block and central fold, rotated 6deg, field inverted (#171717 ground, #FAF8F4 text) | whole book scale 1 -> 2 toward the page block and rotate -4 -> 6deg at 26-40%, covers open 0 -> 10deg and page-edge bands translateY 0 -> -8px, field and motif palette variables swap at 32-34% | text in 34-40, hold 40-60, out 60-66
Scene 3 | 67-100% | centred closing lockup with motif in top 64% box at centre 50%/52%, open book at scale 0.92, rotated 0deg; “Paper Boat” centred in bottom 36%, field #FAF8F4 | book scale 2 -> 0.92 and rotate 6 -> 0deg at 60-74%, covers open 10 -> 28deg and central fold settles 0 -> 4px, field and motif palette variables swap back at 66-68% | text in 68-74, hold 74-100

MOTION: p = clamp(-track.getBoundingClientRect().top / (track.offsetHeight - stage.offsetHeight), 0, 1). One track, one position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh stage, no ancestor with overflow hidden.
Smooth with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Every value is a pure function of drawn, so scrolling back reverses it.
Animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) inside each range. Never prevent or replace native scroll.
Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%. Outgoing text is at opacity 0 before incoming text appears. The motif stays visible through every hand-over.

LOOK: Ground #FAF8F4, text #171717, accent #7A2E2E (shapes only, never text); inverted field #171717 ground, #FAF8F4 text, motif CSS variables shifting to light tones (#D9A6A6 body, #F4D8D8 highlight, #E9B6B6 accent); Bodoni Moda display and Instrument Sans body with Georgia / system-serif and Arial / sans-serif fallbacks. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene, also a category or subject line, is display type: scale down cleanly inside 40% desktop columns or mobile frames so the longest word fits inside its container with at least 24px margin and zero right-edge clipping, and never under 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the stage and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, single motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner `.copy`/`.mask` elements stay at opacity 1 (never leaving Scene 1 hidden at p = 0); at p = 0 the stage starts in Scene 1's opening ground (never inverted at rest), and when a later scene inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited root/stage CSS variables at every breakpoint (>= 4.5:1 contrast); never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries. Line height 1.05 for display, 1.5 for body, mask padding 0.1em.

LAYOUT: The motif lives in one persistent stage-bound centred box (overflow hidden; min-height 0; min-width 0; z-index 1) with overflow-x clip on the stage (never stack duplicate scene SVGs in the sticky stage). At scale 1 the whole silhouette fits inside that box (SVG max-width 85% and max-height 85%, width/height auto, aspect ratio preserved) so nothing clips below the fold at 0% or 100%; draw one unified single-SVG motif (never floating disconnected halves) and animate transform only on the inner graphic, never scale the box itself.
At 1440x900, before the last scene, place the motif box (width 60%, height 100%, overflow hidden) and the text column (width 40%, vertically centred) side by side in separate non-overlapping regions so the motif never bleeds behind text. Scene 1: motif right, text left. Scene 2: motif left, text right.
The last scene is a centred closing lockup, unlike the first: use a two-row grid or flex column of top 64% (minmax(0, 64%), overflow hidden) above bottom 36% (minmax(0, 36%)) at full width so the entire SVG motif stays inside the top 64% box and never shares space with or covers the closing name centred in the bottom 36%.
At 390x844 and 360x640 the box is top 0 to 45% of the stage in every scene and text sits between 52% and 94%, with 24px gutters, centred in the last scene. Text and motif never overlap, nothing is clipped, nothing scrolls sideways; shrink the display size until the longest line fits.

ASSETS: None: draw everything in SVG and CSS. No stock, generated or placeholder media.

FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order, every word visible at opacity 1, sticky stage/track hidden (display none) until active, compact auto-height static sections (no 100svh spacer above text) above the fold with zero overlap; and when the active stage class IS set, hide the static fallback container (display none) so static copy never shows behind or beneath the stage. Keep keyboard scene-jump links visually hidden until focused (:focus-visible) unless a top navbar was requested, so only the active scene copy is shown at rest. JavaScript adds the class that turns on the stage only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce, switches live when that changes, and removes it if setup throws.
Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Failed media shows the drawn still with the text intact; waiting over 300ms shows the drawn still or a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.

AVOID: sections that look like stacked template blocks while motion is on, scroll progress bars, decorative loading bars, card grids, glowing borders, neon or purple-blue gradients, pill badges, text on top of media, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, invented statistics, testimonials, logos, stock media, and placeholder media.

DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% on 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640 the screen matches SCENES, with no overlapping text, empty screen, sideways scroll or console error. Reduced motion and no JavaScript show every word. Tab shows each link in view. Reload at 50% draws the 50% state. Report each check as passed, failed or not run.
```
